meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把互相依赖的一批任务按阶段依次跑完,失败自动重试接管
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一堆有先后依赖的任务需要按顺序自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a batch of dependency-ordered tasks phase by phase, retrying failures automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a set of tasks with dependencies must run automatically in order

howto.what: 把任务拆成有依赖关系的节点图,一个阶段跑一次 workflow,节点按依赖分批执行;单个节点失败可重试、发指令或改定义,已完成节点保留结果。
howto.when: 当你要求 mass-ulw、说明任务之间存在依赖(DAG),或要做部分任务需等待其他任务完成的并行拆分时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次改动拆成有依赖的节点图并跑起来
say.note: 先读规划文档再定义并启动一个阶段的运行

say.text: 重试任务图里失败的那个节点,只重跑它
say.note: 已完成的节点复用缓存结果

say.text: 改一下这个节点的定义再跑,只影响它和下游
say.note: 未变化的已完成节点不重跑

howto.what_en: Turns your request into a dependency-ordered node graph and drives it through the workflow tool, one run per phase; nodes run in waves, and failed nodes can be retried or steered individually while finished nodes keep their results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, describe a task DAG, or need fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others to finish.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to turn this change into a dependency graph and run it.
say_en.note: Reads planning docs, then defines and starts one phase's run.

say_en.text: Retry the failed node in that task graph, only that one.
say_en.note: Completed nodes reuse their cached results.

say_en.text: Amend that node's definition and re-run only what changed.
say_en.note: Only it and its dependents re-run.
